The following market refers to TEN Titans D/ST in the Tennessee vs Indianapolis professional football game originally scheduled for Oct 18, 2026. If TEN Titans D/ST is active but never takes a snap, the market settles to the fair market price before game start. If no touchdowns are scored in the game, the No Touchdown market resolves to Yes and all other player markets resolve to No. Touchdowns scored on fake punts or field goals by the offensive team do not count as a special teams touchdown.
